description:
Delete an AI Tracker (Brand Radar) prompt topic. WARNING: this cascades — every prompt filed under the topic, and all of those prompts' recorded engine responses, are permanently deleted along with the topic. This is irreversible. topicId is the topic UUID (from list_prompt_topics). The response returns prompts_deleted, the number of prompts removed by the cascade. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// delete a prompt topic and every prompt under it
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","topicId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"}
```
name: delete_prompt_topic
title: Delete prompt topic
